_comment: Narration for the README walkthrough, one sentence per entry (Pocket TTS reads single sentences best). 'say' is what the voice reads when it differs from the on-screen text. Scenes follow README.md up to the Mini apps section, then docs/setup-wizard.md; the outro (closing line) always stays last.

sentences.text: This is DocAI.
Think of it as a free, local, open-source Google Drive, built for your financial documents.
sentences.say: Think of it as a free, local, open source Google Drive, built for your financial documents.

sentences.text: Invoices, receipts, bank statements and transactions.
It runs on your own computer, and keeps your files private.
AI extracts the data from every document, organizes it in one database, and connects it into a complete picture of your money flow.
Why DocAI?
The data about your money is all there.
But every document comes in a different format, from a different source, at a different time of the month.
Organizing it in Excel is a full-time job, so most of us just give up.
Then one day you need answers, and you waste days digging through emails and accounts.
How did I miss a tax payment?
Did I get paid for this job?
What is this expense I don't remember making?
You need one place to drop all your documents, let AI do the first pass, and manage it with simple tools.
That's DocAI.
Here's how it works.
First, connect a folder.
Any folder works, even a Google Drive folder synced to your computer.
Second, the data is extracted automatically.
Every document is recognized, and its vendor, dates, totals and line items land in a structured schema.
Third, work with your data.
Browse and search in a Drive-like interface, and match payments to invoices with the built-in reconciliation tool.
sentences.say: Browse and search in a Drive like interface, and match payments to invoices with the built in reconciliation tool.

sentences.text: Here's how I use it every day.
Whenever I get a receipt, I snap a photo and save it to Google Drive.
Once it syncs, DocAI picks it up and extracts the data.
sentences.say: Once it syncs, Doc A I picks it up and extracts the data.

sentences.text: Then I connect Claude Code, and use it to organize my documents, create reports, and link my income to my tax payments.
DocAI is also an MCP server.
sentences.say: DocAI is also an M C P server.

sentences.text: So you can connect Claude, or any AI assistant, and simply ask.
Sort my documents.
Arrange them in folders.
How much did I spend on software in March?
Reconcile these payments with their invoices.
Or build me a mini app.
Mini apps are custom tools built on top of your data.
A monthly expense report, a folder organizer, a bank reconciliation.
The AI builds the app once.
After that, it runs on its own, without calling an AI model.
That makes it faster, deterministic, cheaper, and private.
You can even build a mini app on a few sample documents, then run it on your real ones completely offline.
Setting up DocAI takes a minute.
Install it with two commands, and open it in your browser.
First, choose the folder with your documents.
A Google Drive folder synced to your computer works too.
Then choose where the AI runs.
On your own computer, nothing leaves your machine, but it's slower and needs a strong computer.
With an AI provider you trust, it's fast and accurate, using your own key.
For a local model, DocAI downloads one and runs it for you, or uses Ollama if you already have it.
For a provider, paste your key, and DocAI checks it and loads its models.
A quick test makes sure it all works, and you're done.
You can switch any time in Settings.
Now add your first document.
Upload it, or just drop it in your folder.
It shows up right away, and in a few seconds the AI has read it.
Open it to see everything DocAI extracted, next to the original.
Every line item is there too, and you can correct anything.
DocAI. Your money, finally in one place.
sentences.say: Doc A I. Your money, finally in one place.
